correctness.rationale: The integral Haar kernel has an exact row partition by first diverging dyadic ancestor, yielding R_d=sum (1-sigma_j b_j)/2+|b_d| with b_{j+1}=(b_j+sigma_j)/2, b_0=1 and |b_j|≤1. A global Bellman induction F_h(b)=a_h+c_h|b| solves the recurrence for every h; 0≤c_h≤1 verifies the maximizing branch and the closed expression. Kernel-row sign inputs prove attainment. The included standalone exact checker executed: 8191 exhaustive paths, 2016 independently built full kernel rows, 170 Bellman grid checks. Finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof; d=0 and d=1 handled.
